cancellation.refreshStopped.en: Refresh stopped. Displayed data may be out of date.
cancellation.refreshStopped.zh-CN: 刷新已停止，当前显示的数据可能不是最新状态。

cancellation.refreshRisk.en: The current view is retained and may be out of date. Stopping this read does not undo repository changes.
cancellation.refreshRisk.zh-CN: 将保留当前画面，数据可能不是最新状态。停止读取不会撤销仓库修改。
cancellation.refreshRisk.context: Operation cancellation: protocol, host and workbench confirmation

cancellation.fetchRisk.en: Downloaded objects and completed remote-tracking reference updates are retained. This fetch may be incomplete.
cancellation.fetchRisk.zh-CN: 已下载的对象和已完成的远端跟踪引用更新会保留，本次获取可能不完整。
cancellation.fetchRisk.context: Operation cancellation: protocol, host and workbench confirmation

cancellation.pullRisk.en: Downloads and completed changes are retained. Pull may already be merging or rebasing; local files or the branch may have changed and an unfinished operation may remain. Stopping does not restore the previous state. Check the repository before continuing.
cancellation.pullRisk.zh-CN: 已下载的数据和已完成的修改会保留。拉取可能已进入合并或变基，本地文件或分支可能已变化，也可能留下未完成的操作。停止不会恢复到操作前，请检查仓库状态后继续。
cancellation.pullRisk.context: Operation cancellation: protocol, host and workbench confirmation

cancellation.pushRisk.en: The remote may already have accepted some or all updates. Stopping cannot undo them. Verify the remote result before retrying; the result may be unknown.
cancellation.pushRisk.zh-CN: 远端可能已接受部分或全部更新，停止不能撤销这些更新。停止后结果可能尚未确定，重试前请核实远端状态。
cancellation.pushRisk.context: Operation cancellation: protocol, host and workbench confirmation

cancellation.tagRisk.en: Completed local tag changes and remote updates are retained. Stopping cannot undo them; verify both local and remote tags before retrying.
cancellation.tagRisk.zh-CN: 已完成的本地标签修改和远端更新会保留，停止不能撤销。重试前请核实本地和远端标签状态。
cancellation.tagRisk.context: Operation cancellation: protocol, host and workbench confirmation

cancellation.batchRisk.en: Completed items are retained. Running items will be asked to stop; no later steps will start. Check each repository result.
cancellation.batchRisk.zh-CN: 已完成项目会保留，正在执行的项目将请求停止，后续步骤不再启动。请逐项检查仓库结果。
cancellation.batchRisk.context: Operation cancellation: protocol, host and workbench confirmation

cancellation.confirmationRunning.en: The operation continues while this confirmation is open. Closing this window keeps it running.
cancellation.confirmationRunning.zh-CN: 确认期间操作继续运行，关闭此浮窗将继续操作。
cancellation.confirmationRunning.context: Operation cancellation: protocol, host and workbench confirmation
